triples.relationship: parallel accusation of dispossession and lots
triples.rationale: Obadiah describes foreigners taking strength captive and casting lots over Jerusalem. Joel presents the Lord judging the nations over scattered Israel, the division of His land and lots cast over His people.
triples.source_text: From the day you stood opposed, on the day foreigners took his strength captive and strangers entered his gates and cast lots over Jerusalem, you too were like one of them.

target_units.text: I will gather all the nations and bring them down to the Valley of Jehoshaphat. There I will enter into judgment with them over My people and My inheritance Israel, who were scattered among the nations; and they divided up My land
and cast lots over My people; they gave the boys to prostitutes and sold the girls for wine, which they drank.
